t: This is Charing Cross Hospital, a teaching hospital in Hammersmith. The present building opened in 1973, though the hospital was first established in 1818, about five miles east in central London. A few well-known people were born here, including the actor Hugh Grant, the writer Will Self, and Bruce Reynolds, who masterminded the 1963 Great Train Robbery. Hugh Hudson, who directed Chariots of Fire, died here, as did the actor Jonathan Cecil and the British heavyweight champion boxer James Oyebola.
